question: Shruti departs from her home and walks 47 m towards the west. She then turns right and walks 18 m. She turns left and walks 53 m. She takes a final left turn and walks 30 m.How far is she from a pole which is exactly 12 m to the south of her home? (Assume that all the turns are 90° turns only.)
solution:
Given:

Shruti departs from her home and walks 47 m towards the west.

She then turns right and walks 18 m.

She turns left and walks 53 m.

She takes a final left turn and walks 30 m.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9429b067e44187b48ff2c2835041d582a5b262a78b32592bf739f2a6a92b6e7b.png] 

Now,

 A pole which is exactly 12 m to the south of her home

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cddcdd44b9a30dfb236d2fbd8d6ab27e4401ff3375aa11cb7192835e053be85a.png] 

So, she is 100m away from the pole.

Hence, the correct answer is **" Option 1"**.
